$comment: AI crawler access in robots.txt (SEO & GEO Dashboard Spec, Pratik 29 Oct 2026, section 6; src/pages/robots.txt.ts). true = Allow, false = Disallow the whole site for that crawler. Every crawler not listed falls under 'User-agent: *' = allowed. Edited from the dashboard (Settings > AI crawlers, tools/admin/ui/settings.tsx). Client (30 Oct 2026): AI search bots must be allowed from the root, so the search / answer crawlers are listed as Allow explicitly; Cloudflare's own AI-bot blocking must be off as well. Staging (INDEXABLE = false) disallows everything whatever is set here.
